title: Elevated 5xx responses after application deployment
summary: A fictional deployment was followed by an increase in HTTP 503 responses. Target health checks began failing shortly after the rollout. The sample evidence does not prove a single root cause.
observations: 14:06 UTC HTTP 503 rate increased from 0.2% to 8.4%
14:08 UTC request req-a17 returned 503 from the load balancer
14:09 UTC application logs show readiness check timeout on 3 targets

title: Rate limit responses during a batch job
summary: A fictional batch job sent a higher request rate than the configured service quota. HTTP 429 responses increased, while 5xx rates remained near baseline.
observations: 09:30 UTC batch job eligibility-refresh started with 120 concurrent workers
09:36 UTC retry attempts peaked at 4 times the normal rate
